# BUILD-59 portal demo images (cleaned)

Three licensed photographs, pre-cropped to ratio variants, supplied for the
portal visual pass. Used by scripts/build59-capture.js (demo seeding) and
tests/portal-contrast.test.js (the scrim-over-photo AA proof).

- installation-* — gallery installation with students (the strongest; carries a hero)
- gallery-*      — museum interior (a hero for the second demo org)
- church-*       — sunrise steeple, 400×500 upscaled + hazy: CARD/THUMBNAIL ONLY
  (it will not survive a full-bleed hero at 1440/2560) and the LIGHTEST image,
  so it is the scrim contrast stress test.
